steps: Creation previews a two-leaf v5 all guard, including a shared-state key and payload comparison; its static graph lists the conditions. Cancelling changes no author files.

limitations: Actual Chrome HTTP editor and Godot headless execution in a disposable author workspace. No installed Tauri, Android, Bevy or native visual rendering claim.

A fixture prepares scenes, clips, publisher and an existing v4 TXT. UI previews creation, reviews v5, saves one ordinary TXT, reopens it and plans/builds/runs the frozen project. Initial OC creation and binding are fixture setup.
The graph is a static projection of the current valid form. It does not prove runtime state, reachability or execution.

# Viento animation state script
#@viento-animation-state-script {"format":"viento-animation-state-script","schemaVersion":1,"generator":"godot-gdscript-v4","table":{"initialState":"idle","states":[{"key":"idle"},{"key":"attack"}],"transitions":[{"from":"idle","to":"attack","trigger":{"condition":{"operator":"eq","selector":{"key":"combat.enabled","kind":"projectState"},"type":"boolean","value":true},"kind":"event","name":"action"}}]}}
extends Node

# One controller owns the current scene's animation playhead.
# Empty clip parameters select the whole animation. Clip membership is checked
# by the project port, not by this table. Explicit self-edges restart playback.
@export var clip_idle: String = ""
@export var clip_attack: String = ""
const _INITIAL_STATE: int = 0
const _EVENT_NAMES: Array = ["action"]
const _TRANSITIONS: Array = [{"fromIndex":0,"toIndex":1,"trigger":{"condition":{"type":"boolean","operator":"eq","value":true,"selector":{"key":"combat.enabled","kind":"projectState"}},"kind":"event","name":"action"}}]
var _project
var _event_subscriptions: Array = []
var _completion_subscription: int = 0
var _clips: Array = []
var _state: int = -1
var _selected_clip = null
var _active: bool = false

func _port_valid(project) -> bool:
	return typeof(project) == TYPE_OBJECT and is_instance_valid(project)

func _ready() -> void:
	if not has_meta("viento_project"):
		return
	var project = get_meta("viento_project")
	if not _port_valid(project):
		return
	for method in ["subscribe_event", "unsubscribe_event", "subscribe_animation_completed", "unsubscribe_animation_completed", "select_animation_clip", "play_animation", "read_state"]:
		if not project.has_method(method):
			return
	var clip_pattern := RegEx.new()
	clip_pattern.compile("^[a-f0-9]{8}(?:-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$")
	for value in [clip_idle, clip_attack]:
		var matched = clip_pattern.search(value)
		if not value.is_empty() and (matched == null or matched.get_string() != value):
			_clips.clear()
			push_error("Animation state clip parameters require a lowercase UUID or empty text.")
			return
		_clips.append(null if value.is_empty() else value)
	_project = project
	for event_name in _EVENT_NAMES:
		var token = _project.subscribe_event(event_name, _on_event.bind(event_name))
		if typeof(token) != TYPE_INT or token <= 0:
			_deactivate()
			return
		_event_subscriptions.append(token)
	var completion_token = _project.subscribe_animation_completed(_on_completed)
	if typeof(completion_token) != TYPE_INT or completion_token <= 0:
		_deactivate()
		return
	_completion_subscription = completion_token
	_active = true
	_enter_state(_INITIAL_STATE)

func _enter_state(next_state: int) -> bool:
	if not _active or not _port_valid(_project):
		_deactivate()
		return false
	var selection = _clips[next_state]
	if not _project.select_animation_clip(selection):
		_deactivate()
		return false
	if not _project.play_animation():
		# Fail-stop only: a previously accepted select is not rolled back.
		_deactivate()
		return false
	_state = next_state
	_selected_clip = selection
	return true

func _on_event(value, event_name: String) -> bool:
	if not _active or not _port_valid(_project):
		_deactivate()
		return false
	for edge in _TRANSITIONS:
		var trigger: Dictionary = edge["trigger"]
		if edge["fromIndex"] == _state and trigger["kind"] == "event" and trigger["name"] == event_name:
			if trigger.has("condition"):
				var condition: Dictionary = trigger["condition"]
				var actual = value
				if condition.has("selector"):
					# Read at delivery time; publishing freezes only the event payload.
					actual = _project.read_state(condition["selector"]["key"])
				if not _condition_matches(actual, condition):
					continue
			return _enter_state(edge["toIndex"])
	return true

func _condition_matches(value, condition: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var kind: int = typeof(value)
	var operator: String = condition["operator"]
	if condition["type"] == "number":
		if kind != TYPE_INT and kind != TYPE_FLOAT:
			return false
		var actual: float = float(value)
		if not is_finite(actual) or abs(actual) > 1000000000.0:
			return false
		var expected: float = PackedByteArray(condition["valueBytes"]).decode_double(0)
		match operator:
			"eq": return actual == expected
			"ne": return actual != expected
			"lt": return actual < expected
			"lte": return actual <= expected
			"gt": return actual > expected
			"gte": return actual >= expected
		return false
	if condition["type"] == "boolean":
		if kind != TYPE_BOOL:
			return false
		return value == condition["value"] if operator == "eq" else value != condition["value"]
	if condition["type"] == "string":
		if kind != TYPE_STRING or value.to_utf8_buffer().size() > 4096:
			return false
		for index in range(value.length()):
			var code: int = value.unicode_at(index)
			if code < 0 or code > 0x10ffff or (code >= 0xd800 and code <= 0xdfff):
				return false
		# Compare UTF-8 bytes without decoding the declared text: Godot String
		# decoding truncates embedded NUL, which must never match its prefix.
		var encoded: String = "" if value.is_empty() else Marshalls.raw_to_base64(value.to_utf8_buffer())
		return encoded == condition["valueBase64"] if operator == "eq" else encoded != condition["valueBase64"]
	return false

func _on_completed(clip_id) -> bool:
	if not _active or not _port_valid(_project):
		_deactivate()
		return false
	if clip_id != _selected_clip:
		return true
	for edge in _TRANSITIONS:
		if edge["fromIndex"] == _state and edge["trigger"]["kind"] == "completed":
			return _enter_state(edge["toIndex"])
	return true

func _deactivate() -> void:
	var project = _project
	var events = _event_subscriptions
	var completion = _completion_subscription
	_project = null
	_event_subscriptions = []
	_completion_subscription = 0
	_active = false
	_state = -1
	_selected_clip = null
	_clips.clear()
	if not _port_valid(project):
		return
	if project.has_method("unsubscribe_event"):
		for token in events:
			project.unsubscribe_event(token)
	if completion != 0 and project.has_method("unsubscribe_animation_completed"):
		project.unsubscribe_animation_completed(completion)

func _exit_tree() -> void:
	_deactivate()
